channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: McFaul out of Derry reckoning as Slaughtneil stars return
item.description: New Derry football boss Ciaran Meenagh is planning without Ciaran McFaul for the 2026 campaign.

item.title: Mitchell named Offaly hurling captain
item.description: Charlie Mitchell has been appointed as the Offaly senior hurling captain for 2026, succeeding Ciarán Burke in the role.

item.title: Brothers marked each other in Sigerson Cup game
item.description: Last Wednesday night's Sigerson Cup Round 1 tie between MTU Cork and UL was notable for a most unusual occurrence which saw siblings Keith and Paddy O'Driscoll mark one another.

item.title: Donegal to begin Ulster SFC defence in Letterkenny
item.description: Donegal will begin their bid for a three-in-a-row of Ulster SFC titles in Letterkenny later this year.

item.title: Kerry clubs raise big money online ahead of All-Ireland finals
item.description: Kerry clubs Dingle, An Ghaeltacht and Ballymacelligott have raised €160,000 between them online ahead of their upcoming All-Ireland finals.

item.title: Profound sadness at passing of Mattie Lennon
item.description: The death has taken place of former Monaghan, Tyrone and Armagh hurling manager Mattie Lennon.

item.title: Club calls for Down's withdrawal from Allianz Leagues
item.description: Saval GAC has called for Down's withdrawal from the National Leagues in protest at Allianz's sponsorship of the competitions.

item.title: Maguire to captain Cork footballers
item.description: Ian Maguire has been handed the Cork football captaincy for 2026.

item.title: GAA on TV: All-Ireland club finals take centre stage
item.description: There will be live television coverage of the All-Ireland club hurling and football finals from Croke Park this weekend.

item.title: "Every county does go through a transitional phase"
item.description: On November 15 of last year, Cork football legend Juliet Murphy found herself at The Bonnington Dublin Hotel for a very special occasion.
